lsd.subtitle: Jeu de société mulitjoueur en ligne
lsd.description: Let's Summon Demons is an online multiplayer board game where players must summon demons to win the game. The game takes place in a retro satanic universe and offers strategy and cooperation mechanics.
lsd.context:
Let's Summon Demons is the first game I started developing in my spare time.

It is based on an existing board game that I adapted for the web.

There were four of us friends working on the project in total: three developers and one UI/UX designer.

As for the developers, one was responsible for setting up the technologies and the project's architecture, whilst the other two (including myself) worked on developing the features for all the game's rules (card abilities, game mechanics, etc.).

The game isn't finished yet as it requires a lot of time and effort, but we hope to be able to unveil it to the public soon.
